policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.

applicable: v0.8.36 Studio pause behavior requires the preview to remain visually still; reCast now pauses animations and media in the same-origin preview when Studio playback pauses, rewinds, or completes.
v0.8.36 Studio edit behavior is already compatible because reCast updates the existing srcdoc preview rather than reloading the preview iframe for each control/edit operation.
v0.8.36 native VP9/AV1 opening behavior is not directly applicable because reCast Studio does not perform a browser-video transcoding/prewarm pipeline when opening projects.
v0.8.36 studio-server identifyFileWrite rename is not applicable because reCast does not expose the HyperFrames studio-server receipt API.
v0.8.36 BROWSER_HOSTILE_CODECS object contract is not applicable because reCast does not expose that studio-server codec registry interface.

The 2026-09-13 upstream nested-sibling video layout fix is not directly applicable because reCast does not implement HyperFrames' sub-composition layout/visibility engine; its renderer captures the supplied DOM directly.
Catalog-only changes are not applicable to reCast runtime compatibility.
release_assessment.implementation_action: Independently mirror the applicable Studio pause semantics and add an end-to-end regression assertion; update the compatibility snapshot to the current upstream revision and release.
